integrity: Symbolic scattering reduction and Descartes uniqueness argument; numerical cross-checker reproduces matching calculations. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Linear one-particle stationary two-port tight-binding scattering at exactly the band centre; fixed sum of purely imaginary onsite loss strengths; no robustness or broadband optimality theorem. Near-perfect one-sided absorption already exists in prior asymmetric-resonator work. Residual priority uncertainty for equivalent specialized two-defect treatments.
title: Exact parity dichotomy and uniquely optimal loss allocation for two absorbing lattice sites
